title: shipping

requirementInput.text:
For a built-in int amount_cents from 0 to 9999, shipping.fee(amount_cents) returns the integer 1000 cents.
For a built-in int amount_cents of at least 10000, shipping.fee(amount_cents) returns the integer 0 cents, including exactly 10000.
For negative built-in int amount_cents, shipping.fee raises ValueError.
For any argument whose type is not the built-in int, including bool, shipping.fee raises TypeError.

tests.code:
import shipping


def test_fee_in_range_boundaries_and_integer_result():
    for amount_cents in (0, 9999):
        result = shipping.fee(amount_cents)
        assert isinstance(result, int)
        assert not isinstance(result, bool)
        assert result == 1000
tests.quote: For a built-in int amount_cents from 0 to 9999, shipping.fee(amount_cents) returns the integer 1000 cents.

import shipping


def test_fee_at_and_above_threshold_returns_integer_zero():
    for amount_cents in (10000, 10001):
        result = shipping.fee(amount_cents)
        assert isinstance(result, int)
        assert not isinstance(result, bool)
        assert result == 0
